subject: re-doc
title: (R)RE.DOC.-----AF.DY.
description: Diagram in TRF(II)-17. The prose above identifies the structural target: 'the collective forces of western culture function as a negative factor with regards to the actualness of creativity from every sector of the planet - especially if the creator is not a white man.' The crossing diagrams how reality-of-redocumentation structurally meets affinity-dynamics at the creative-women-evaluation scale: (R)RE-DOC crossed with AF-DY. RE-DOC sits at left with the subject-arrow; AF-DY at center-bottom as partner-axis. C-INFO (composite information) sits at a junction on the upper branch, which carries INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and runs on to MT-INTR (multiple interpretation); a second MT-INTR branches at C-INFO. CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) runs right from the main line and carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification); SG (source initiation) branches from T-C-IMP and carries STF (source transfer), and RT-DY (reality dynamics) drops from CULT-SOLD. TR (transformation) drops from the main line and carries VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), which carries PER-DY (perception dynamics).
